spec_match.rationale: Live row calls the real navigator.mediaSession.setMicrophoneActive(false); model rows reproduce the two IDL signatures and the spec's rejection exactly and are labelled as models, never presented as the browser.

interactive.rationale: Run-matrix button and a toggle for the rejecting model; 6 patterns × up to 4 targets rendered with ok/BREAKS and verbatim text, and a live-specific breakage verdict.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises the six patterns and the TypeError on Chrome 158 for .then(); observed verbatim ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'then')').

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes synchronous throws from escaped rejections, and captures fire-and-forget unhandled rejections (preventDefault so they are shown, not lost).

conformance.rationale: Migration is advice rather than a spec contract; it relies on the returns-promise assertions for the live shape.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified with headless Chrome for Testing 153 via Playwright (chrome-devtools-mcp is NOT available in this environment, so this is not DevTools-MCP verification). Chrome 153 has the OLD shape; the new-shape branches were exercised only with a test-only init-script shim in the harness (never shipped). Default: live breaks A (.then) and B (.catch) with synchronous TypeError; safe on all targets C, D, E (F also when the rejecting model is excluded). Shim: live row passes all; same safe set. Zero console errors (the captured unhandled rejection is suppressed by design).

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5188639100370944 plus the spec section and MDN/WebIDL/HTML references relevant to this concept.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only (bg-paper/stone/ivory, text-charcoal/black/muted, accent-emerald-dark/rose/blue/amber-as-border-only); every button override sets both background and color; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Checkbox has a visible label and 44px target; verdict aria-live polite; result rows convey ok/BREAKS in text, not colour alone; code samples focusable.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at 360x740 (DPR 3, touch, isMobile) and 1280x800: 0px horizontal overflow on both, button rows wrap, 44px targets, screenshots read for both classes.

telemetry_health.rationale: demo-telemetry.js loaded; showcaseTelemetry.assert fires for the primary contract and for the legacy/fallback branch with the raw shape/state as details.

openQuestions.title: Add a TypeScript/lib.dom note
openQuestions.detail: TypeScript's lib.dom typing of these methods may still say void; a note on the typing drift would help migrators.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region for asynchronous result announcements
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-live=polite for standard result/status updates; reserve assertive for critical interruptions; avoid announcing interstitial 'loading' noise.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts/readouts are aria-live polite; per-call result cards and logs are NOT live (they are navigable on demand) to avoid spam.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: flex-wrap:wrap on button rows, min-inline-size:0 on items holding long strings, auto-fit/minmax grids, never mask overflow with overflow:hidden.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Button groups wrap; result grids use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%,Npx),1fr)); outputs use overflow-wrap:anywhere; measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800.

guidanceConsulted.query: status result colour not the only indicator
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Do not rely on colour alone to convey state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each cell's label text states ok or BREAKS; the coloured border is decorative reinforcement.

summary: A compatibility matrix that shows which calling patterns break on which signature, with the async-wrapper pattern recommended and proven safe on every target.
